analysis.title: GS Sharkey - US Equities Mid Day Color 8 Oct 2026
key_insights: Defensive tilt to the tape on Middle East escalation fears, with WTI back above $90 and yields elevated. Headlines of 'TRUMP: NOT BE ATTACKING IRAN AT ANY TIME PRIOR TO THE MIDTERM' are whipsawing the tape.
SPX has outperformed RTY for the 5th straight session. The index is breaking under its 200-day moving average (2,787).
The AI ecosystem is weak: Data Centers (GSTMTDAT) -370bps, Memory (GSTMTMEM) -300bps, Semis (GSTMTSEM) -366bps.
Cons Staples (GSXUSTAP) +180bps and Restaurants (GSXUREST) +180bps outperform. Most Short basket (GSCBMSAL) -280bps, working for the third consecutive session.
MegaCap vs Non Profitable Tech (GSPUMENP) +315bps, with the dispersion led by underperformance in the non-profitable leg.

AVGO -340bps, said to be in talks to arrange about $30 billion in debt financing to help OpenAI buy custom AI chips the companies are developing together (BBG). Tencent is mulling a $5 billion bond sale.

Privo's take on why real yields refuse to come down: if scarce compute can generate 20-30% compounding IRRs, borrowers will accept high single digit rates to build it, which strains consumers, small businesses and governments built for cheap capital.
Healthcare is heavy (XLV -100bps) on one-offs: ARGX -12% on a negative Sjogren's setback, Tools (GSHLCTOO) -2200bps retracing after peak AI drug discovery euphoria earlier in the week.
Managed Care is jittery ahead of imminent STARs ratings. No update is out yet.

Waller said two more hikes are appropriate. GS economics (GIR) still expects one additional 25bps hike in December and has lowered its probability that the FOMC passes on a December hike, because Waller's speech is a hawkish shift from prior comments.

GS desk flow: activity is 4 out of 10 and skewed better for sale from both long-only and hedge fund clients. Asset managers are 5% better sellers (macro products, industrials, healthcare) against demand in energy and consumer staples. Hedge funds are much better sellers (info tech, macro products, comms services, consumer staples) with modest demand only in materials.
Chart of the Day: US Cyclicals vs the S&P 500 is at its lowest level in three years.
